title: Freight Damage Checklist
subtitle: Freight Damage: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Freight Damage Checklist covers freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action. The freight exception coordinator records Freight Damage criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Freight Damage Checklist keeps Freight Damage exceptions visible until the freight exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Freight Damage Checklist at trailer, dock, warehouse zone, delivery location, and protected evidence area. Document freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action identity before Freight Damage begins. Compare freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action findings with stated Freight Damage criteria; route unresolved Freight Damage issues to claims or cargo-condition reviewer. For Freight Damage Checklist, confirm requirements for Freight Damage. Ask claims or cargo-condition reviewer to review Freight Damage conditions beyond the freight exception coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Freight Damage, identify responsible parties, trailer, dock, warehouse zone, delivery location, and protected evidence area, and the linked freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action source.

fields.label: Shipment, order, bill, and claim reference
Carrier, trailer, seal, and custody identifiers
Item, lot, serial, package, and affected-quantity identity

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Freight Damage facts for freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Freight Damage inspection checks
items: Damage type, location, extent, and discovery time
Packaging, pallet, restraint, and moisture condition
Seal, vehicle, dock, and handling context
Salvage, quarantine, rework, or mitigation action

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Freight Damage evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Freight Exception Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Product creates safety or contamination concern
Liability or disposition decision requested without review
blocks.guidance: Pause Freight Damage when affected scope, evidence preservation, safe containment, notice, or authorized disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Freight Damage proof and route unresolved freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action scope to freight exception coordinator.
